blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
What usually goes wrong, and the specific guard in this build:

items: OT/IT blur
OT/IT blur — control traffic never crosses zones without a broker; laptops do not talk to PLCs, enforced by the platform rather than by discipline alone
Override culture
Override culture: operators can reject any recommendation in one tap — rejections are mined weekly, not punished; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase
Twin decay
Twin decay — models are recalibrated against plant truth every shift; a drifting twin loses control authority automatically
